### knobValue

A knob is a string, number or boolean.

Type: `string or number or boolean`

### secretRef

### tlsClientCert

A client certificate to present: the tls.crt and tls.key of the named kubernetes.io/tls Secret.

| Field       | Type                                       | Required | Description |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------------ | -------- | ----------- |
| `secretRef` | [secretRef](/reference/runspec/#secretref) | Yes      |             |

### tlsDisabled

enabled false: plain HTTP or TCP, with no TLS from servtuner. Use it where a service mesh or an encrypted CNI encrypts the connection, or for local testing. Carries no certificate settings.

| Field     | Type    | Required | Description |
| --------- | ------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `enabled` | `false` | Yes      |             |

### tlsEnabled

enabled true: TLS. The server is verified against the system pool plus SSL\_CERT\_FILE, and the ca.crt of caSecretRef when it is set; the certificate of clientCert is presented when it is set.

| Field         | Type                                               | Required | Description                                                                                      |
| ------------- | -------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `enabled`     | `true`                                             | Yes      |                                                                                                  |
| `clientCert`  | [tlsClientCert](/reference/runspec/#tlsclientcert) | No       |                                                                                                  |
| `caSecretRef` | [secretRef](/reference/runspec/#secretref)         | No       | A Secret whose ca.crt is the private CA that signed the server certificate. Only ca.crt is read. |

### tls

Transport security of one connection on which servtuner is the client, discriminated by enabled. Required wherever it appears: it is never inferred.

Type: [tlsDisabled](/reference/runspec/#tlsdisabled) or [tlsEnabled](/reference/runspec/#tlsenabled)

### sharedPrefix

Every prompt starts with one of groups fixed prefixes of tokens tokens (a shared system prompt), so a prefix cache sees real reuse inside a run. input\_tokens is the whole prompt, prefix included, so its mean must exceed tokens. Not with conversation or the embeddings api.

| Field    | Type      | Required | Description                                                                 |
| -------- | --------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `tokens` | `integer` | Yes      | Length of each shared prefix, in tokens. ≥ 1                                |
| `groups` | `integer` | Yes      | How many different prefixes; each request uses one, chosen by the seed. ≥ 1 |

### workload

The request mix. Either a preset ("preset": "name@version"), which supplies the dataset, conversation and api, or those fields written out; never both, so a preset name always means one exact workload. bench expands a preset when it resolves the spec. streaming is required either way, and seed may accompany a preset. api has a default that the generated types write back, so the schema cannot forbid it beside a preset; bench rejects an api that differs from the preset's.

| Field          | Type                                                   | Required | Description                                                                                                                         |
| -------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `preset`       | [presetReference](/reference/runspec/#presetreference) | No       | A workload preset, name@version (schema/presets). Mutually exclusive with dataset and conversation; an api must match the preset's. |
| `api`          | [workloadApi](/reference/runspec/#workloadapi)         | No       | Default: `"chat"`.                                                                                                                  |
| `streaming`    | `boolean`                                              | Yes      | Required, not defaulted: go-jsonschema cannot round-trip an explicit false over a default of true.                                  |
| `dataset`      | [dataset](/reference/runspec/#dataset)                 | No       |                                                                                                                                     |
| `seed`         | `integer`                                              | No       | Default: `0`.                                                                                                                       |
| `conversation` | [conversation](/reference/runspec/#conversation)       | No       |                                                                                                                                     |

### analysisLimits

Which limits the sizing recommends ("Limits policy"). cpu follow recommends a CPU limit only when the captured pod spec has one; memory defaults to set, because a memory limit is the OOM boundary; qos guaranteed sets limits equal to requests for every resource.

| -------- | ------------------------------------------------ | -------- | ----------------------- |
| `cpu`    | [limitsPolicy](/reference/runspec/#limitspolicy) | No       | Default: `"follow"`.    |
| `memory` | [limitsPolicy](/reference/runspec/#limitspolicy) | No       | Default: `"set"`.       |
| `qos`    | `"burstable"`, `"guaranteed"`                    | No       | Default: `"burstable"`. |

### targetMetrics

Where Prometheus finds the series of a target that is not a Kubernetes workload (a bare process or a host outside the cluster). The scrape job attaches these namespace and pod labels to the target (deploy/prometheus/servtuner-external.values.yaml), so bench selects its series as it selects a pod's. Not used with workload: a Kubernetes target is found through its snapshot.

| Field       | Type     | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| ----------- | -------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `job`       | `string` | No       | The scrape job. Default: `"servtuner-external"`.                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| `namespace` | `string` | Yes      |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `pod`       | `string` | Yes      |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `node`      | `string` | No       | The host label its GPU exporter's series carry, which that scrape job sets to a stable name (deploy/prometheus/servtuner-external.values.yaml): the dcgm catalog selects an off-cluster GPU by it, as it selects a Kubernetes node by name. |

### infraPricingPolicy

Where infrastructure prices come from. bench snapshots the resolved prices into pricing/infra.json, and servtuner analyze prices from that copy.

| Field      | Type                                                     | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                  |
| ---------- | -------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `source`   | `"none"`, `"static"`, `"aws"`                            | No       | none disables the infrastructure cost objectives; static reads the table below; aws queries the AWS Price List API for the snapshot's node instance type. Default: `"none"`. |
| `discount` | `number`                                                 | No       | A multiplier on every resolved price, for Spot, reserved instances or Savings Plans, which are not modelled. &gt; 0; ≤ 1 Default: `1`.                                       |
| `static`   | [staticPriceTable](/reference/runspec/#staticpricetable) | No       |                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `aws`      | [awsPricing](/reference/runspec/#awspricing)             | No       |                                                                                                                                                                              |

### staticPriceTable

Prices for local and on-prem hardware. A node type is priced per hour with its allocatable resources, so a pod's share can be computed; a GPU model is priced per GPU-hour, directly or from the owned-hardware helper.

| Field   | Type                                                          | Required | Description                                                                  |
| ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `nodes` | map of [staticNodePrice](/reference/runspec/#staticnodeprice) | No       | Keyed by node.kubernetes.io/instance-type, or local.                         |
| `gpus`  | map of [staticGpuPrice](/reference/runspec/#staticgpuprice)   | No       | Keyed by the GPU model the snapshot records (hardware\_profile.accelerator). |

The machine a target outside Kubernetes runs on, as its host record says: there are no nodes to read it from. The analysis scopes and prices the run by it when the snapshot has no hardware profile for the target; a captured profile always wins.

| `host`             | `string`  | Yes      | The host's name: the run's node\_instance\_type. |
| `accelerator`      | `string`  | Yes      | The GPU model, or none.                          |
| `gpu_count`        | `integer` | Yes      | The GPUs the target uses: one replica's. ≥ 0     |
| `gpu_memory_bytes` | `integer` | No       | ≥ 0                                              |
| `driver_version`   | `string`  | No       |                                                  |
| `cpu_model`        | `string`  | No       |                                                  |
| `cpu_cores`        | `integer` | No       | ≥ 0                                              |

### staticGpuPrice

Either usd\_per\_hour, or owned hardware: purchase\_usd ÷ amortization\_hours + watts ÷ 1000 × usd\_per\_kwh.

| Field                | Type     | Required | Description                                                      |
| -------------------- | -------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `usd_per_hour`       | `number` | No       | ≥ 0                                                              |
| `purchase_usd`       | `number` | No       | ≥ 0                                                              |
| `amortization_hours` | `number` | No       | &gt; 0                                                           |
| `watts`              | `number` | No       | Board power: the GPU's TDP, since measured power needs DCGM. ≥ 0 |
| `usd_per_kwh`        | `number` | No       | ≥ 0                                                              |

Exactly which fields are allowed together is restricted further by the schema.

### tokenPricingPolicy

Token cost for routers in front of priced providers. With datasheet, servtuner run fetches the pricing datasheet once and stores it in the bundle; the analysis prices only from that copy. With manual, the prices are given here (a private API no datasheet lists).

| Field             | Type                                                       | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| ----------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `source`          | `"none"`, `"datasheet"`, `"manual"`                        | No       | Default: `"none"`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `from_price_book` | `boolean`                                                  | No       | Fetch the datasheet the operator supplied in the install's price book, from the api (GET /runs/{id}/datasheet) with the run's token. Needs servtuner run --api-url. Not with url. Default: `false`.                                                               |
| `url`             | `string`                                                   | No       | The datasheet to fetch. Default: the price book's (from\_price\_book), else the Bifrost target's own framework\_config.pricing\_url, else https://getbifrost.ai/datasheet, which servtuner run --offline never fetches. The format is LiteLLM's model-price JSON. |
| `manual`          | [manualTokenPrices](/reference/runspec/#manualtokenprices) | No       |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |

### conversation

Multi-turn chat. Request i is turn (i / concurrent) mod turns of the conversation in slot i mod concurrent, so this many conversations interleave and each restarts after its last turn. A turn sends the whole history: the earlier user messages (input\_tokens each) and synthetic assistant replies (output\_tokens each), the same text every turn, so the server sees a growing, repeated prefix. The replies are stand-ins, not the server's own, so a turn does not wait for the previous one: pacing stays RPS-driven. Chat only.

| Field        | Type      | Required | Description                                           |
| ------------ | --------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| `turns`      | `integer` | Yes      | ≥ 2; ≤ 100                                            |
| `concurrent` | `integer` | No       | Conversations in progress at once. ≥ 1 Default: `64`. |

| `version` | `integer` | Yes      | ≥ 1                         |
